summary: Completed backend testing of Email Templates Management System. All 20 API tests passed. Verified all 17 templates are correctly loaded including the 6 new templates (athlete_cancellation, volunteer_cancellation, volunteer_verification_code, volunteer_edit_link, payment_rejected, athlete_edit_code).
critical_code_review_comments: All 17 email templates are correctly defined in DEFAULT_TEMPLATES
Merge fields are properly organized by source (race, athlete, volunteer, payment, general)
Template rendering correctly replaces {{field_name}} patterns with sample data
Test email endpoint successfully sends emails via Gmail SMTP
Reset endpoint correctly restores templates to default values
Preview endpoint returns rendered subject and content with sample data
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use existing templates from DEFAULT_TEMPLATES
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email templates system fully tested. All 17 templates verified: 5 atletas, 6 voluntarios, 4 pagos, 2 sistema. Gmail SMTP is configured and working for test emails.

GET /api/email-templates/.description: Returns all 17 templates with correct structure (id, name, description, subject, content, category, merge_sources)

GET /api/email-templates/merge-fields.description: Returns merge fields organized by 5 sources: race, athlete, volunteer, payment, general

GET /api/email-templates/{template_id}.description: Returns specific template by ID, 404 for non-existent

PUT /api/email-templates/{template_id}.description: Updates template subject and content, persists changes

POST /api/email-templates/reset/{templat.description: Resets template to default values from DEFAULT_TEMPLATES

POST /api/email-templates/preview.description: Returns rendered preview with sample data replacing merge fields

POST /api/email-templates/test.description: Sends test email via Gmail SMTP with sample data
